title: Ashland's Adena mounds

bodyMarkdown:
Six conical Adena burial mounds survive in Ashland's Central Park, roughly 15–20 feet across and 4–6 feet high in a slight curve. A 1930s survey said no Kentucky city held more prehistoric evidence than Ashland, though many other local mounds were leveled for streets and buildings. The mounds mark Woodland mound-builder presence along the Ohio centuries before historic tribes.
Source: [https://explorekyhistory.ky.gov/items/show/595](https://explorekyhistory.ky.gov/items/show/595)
Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adena_culture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adena_culture)
